balls.text: he has a five-for! In a two-over spell! Russell applying the perfect finishing touch to a solid bowling performance. This is a length ball at middle stump, he shuffles and looks for the slog over midwicket. Can only get it as far as long-on. Russell spreads his arms and shrieks in celebration
short of deep midwicket. By some distance. Short of a length and cramped at the chest. Takes the pull on and ends up slicing it
taken at deep midwicket! Four for Andre. Short and across middle stump, wants to pull that over square. Ends up slicing it and Shakib runs in and takes that with ease

chipped straight to short fine. Russell has three. Slower short ball at leg stump. Krunal looks to get inside the line and get this pull over that fiedler. But the change in pace doesn't allow a clean swing and it is an easy take
edge flies past short third. Short and just outside off. Cramped on the cut but he finds some fortune

slugged between long-on and deep midwicket. Ugly but effective. This is full at off stump, he gets his weight back to create swinging room and it comes off the inside half of the bat. But there is a big enough gap there for him to get four
full and just outside off at 141kph. Looks to scythe that past point, finds him on the bounce
full and wide outside off, slashed out to sweeper cover
slower short ball at leg stump, looks for the hook, out of control. Top edge clears the keeper
beats Harbhajan to the left at fine leg. Length ball at the pads, looks to shovel that and misses. It's off his pads and teases the fielder before trickling into the padding
good length on off stump, defended into the covers
yorker length at middle stump, flicked to deep square
full and wide outside off, steers it to sweeper point
length and across off stump, stays deep in the crease and runs this to deep backward point's left
length at off stump, punched on the up to sweeper cover
picks out sweeper cover. Length ball across off stump, gets on the front foot and opens the face on his lofted drive. Can't go through with it and it ends up a friendly slice for the bowler
bouncer dug in too short, can't even attempt a shot at that
caught behind! Full and wide outside off, Pollard shuffles and looks to drill this through the covers. Thick outside edge. DK is wide in his stance for Russell's angle and has an easy one
short of a length and across the corridor, beaten on the late cut
offcutter at a length outside off, shuffles and clips to midwicket
short and just outside off. Pollard steps into the off side but that has taken away swinging room. Defended down the pitch
slower ball, short of a length at off stump. Waits on it and jabs to third man
short of a length and rising over off stump. Krunal wants to chop that to third man but it's past him quickly

taken at mid-off. Hardik's struggle ends. Prasidh slows it down this time. Full offcutter at off stump as Hardik gets deep in the crease with the front leg away - his position for the big slog. Forced to go straight, forced to go through it too soon. Russell takes him
slashed over point. Short of a length and wide outside off. Stays put, stays leg side, swings from under it
steps out and leaves! That should sum up how good Cummins has been today, he's been on every batsman's mind as he's run. Short of a length outside off this time

inside edge to fine leg. Whew. Pollard is not enjoying this at the moment, has looked unsettled every ball. This time he jumps into the off side, Cummins jags it in off the seam. He only manages to swish the bat at that
cuts through him. Short of a length and into the corridor. Gets on the front foot to try and defend that. Halfway between a flick and forward block and that is past the inside edge
panic but safe in the end. Short and into the body, dropped into the leg side and wants to get to the other end. Cummins is quickly onto that from his follow through. Hardik sends his partner back

chopped on! Once again Cummins does the job he's asked to! Slower ball, an offcutter at length wide outside off. Rohit static with the feet and looks to swish at that away from the body. Can't get it away
short and rising up at the chest. Hurriedly dropped into the covers with soft hands
good length and in at the stumps. Steps into the off side and uses the angle to scoop this to deep square's right
deftly done! Short of a length and sliding into the corridor. Clears the front leg and makes room to steer this fine of short third
length outside off, leans in and drives to deep extra
wrong'un, short of a length and getting big after pitching. Hardik defends into the leg side
short of a length at off stump, punched to deep extra off the back foot
length outside off, gets across for the paddle, can't beat short fine
short of a length at off stump, looks to work that into the leg side. Gets it to third man off the outside edge
brings out the signature pull. Short and rising at the body, which is stock from Prasidh. Rohit gets that half stride out and languidly puts this over the midwicket boundary
short and just outside off, pulled to deep square off the thick inside edge

whipped over midwicket. I saw him taking his guard before this ball, wonder if he's marked middle stump and moved across. Coz he is in perfect position for the angle into him. Short of a length, nice pace, and he uses that
short and tight at middle again. Hardik is itching for room but they're forcing him to jab to the fielders at the moment
short of a length and tight at middle stump, makes room to try and punch but he is hurried. That trickles into the leg side
tossed up outside off, driven along the floor to long-off
good length at off stump, blocked on the front foot
short of a length and just outside off, punched to sweeper's right
legcutter gets the leading edge. Looped in at a length on off stump, wants to flick for the angle
length and just outside off, comes in off the surface. Looks to drive on the rise, thick inside edge towards long-on
short and wide outside off, beaten on the cut
short at middle stump, takes his eyes off this as he pulls to deep square
short of a length in the corridor, hurriedly tapped to point
short and rising at on off stump line, nicely on top of the bounce to steer that to third man
short and wide outside off, goes too hard on the cut and mistimes. Rolls out to sweeper cover
short of a length and into the corridor, left alone

right on cue! Tucks him up at the ribs, Kishan's response usually is to get inside the line, drop his shoulders into the off side and hook aerially. That's what he does this time but he's hit it straight to fine leg
short of a length at middle stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
length and pushed through quick outside off, pushed into the covers off the front foot
tossed up at middle, steps out and flicks between deep midwicket and long-on

high in the sky but Gill is comfortable under that coming in from long-on. Oh this is a lovely delivery. Shakib is in control tonight. Tosses it up, just short of a good length. Offers no pace and gets that to dip on SKY who has stepped out and isn't to the pitch of it. Looks like he wanted to go over extra cover, one of his stock shots against spin, but he got nothing from the bowler. Only managed to lift that high up and his rollicking innings comes to an end
edge and past short third. Short of a length, an arm ball sliding into the corridor. Wants to slap that through the covers but it's onto him a little quick
length ball wide outside off, driven on the rise to long-off
slower short ball at off stump, shuffles and pulls to fine leg's left

see ya! Onto the roof! Good length and into the corridor and once again he uses the angle to his advantage, this time to bring up the fifty. Jumps behind the line of this , front leg out of the way and then serious whippage
short of a length just outside off, chopped to third man off the back foot
short of a length and tight on off stump. Shuffles for the short-arm pull and cops that on the thigh
quickly past the outside edge. Short of a length in the corridor, wants to run that down to third man but his feet aren't organised quickly enough
short of a length in the corridor, opens the face and ramps that towards third man
length at middle stump, steps out and punches to long-on
good on off stump, driven with the turn to deep extra
good length and into the stumps, punched on the rise to long-off
short of a length and wide outside off, skids on low. Chopped off the under-edge to deep extra
good length and into leg stump, leans in and flicks to long-on
good length and sticking in the surface as he get son the back foot and forces this to long-off
short of a length and just outside off, opens the face and steers to third man
good length and slanted into the corridor, hangs leg side of it and has a swish at it with an open face. Off the thick outside edge and quickly to the third man boundary
uff, this is genius. Uses the same angle into him to open up the off side this time. Stays leg side of this length ball, so it comes on nicely for the drive on the rise between mid-off and extra

oh gorgeous. Prasidh's angling it into the stumps and SKY has figured that out. Steps into the off side to set up and then it looks like a half-volley on leg stump. He whips it into the boundary padding at deep midwicket
length and into the corridor, driven on the rise to extra cover
good length and in at off stump, gets a nice stride out and drives to sweeper cover
length on off stump, steps out and clips to long-on's right
good length and sliding onto the stumps, backs away and punches to deep extra
full and drifted into the pads, flicked to short fine
full and flat at off stump, driven to deep extra cover
good length on off stump, dabbed into the covers with soft hands to steal the run. A direct hit at the striker's end from Shakib is sent upstairs but the batsman was in comfortably
tossed up at off stump, driven with the turn to long-off
slower ball at a length outside off, punched to sweeper's right
good length and just outside off, punched to extra cover
stretches his arms and slaps that past cover point. Good length and wide outside off, sliding on nicely for the drive on the up and he gets his arms through this quickly
short of a length and just outside off, an offcutter. Mistimed punch towards extra cover
good length and speared in at middle stump. Defended into the pitch
short of a length and in the corridor, chopped into the covers
length at off stump, gets low for the sweep and lifts it over square leg
length and in at middle stump, goes inside-out and drives to mid-off
short of a length and fired down leg side
short and hurrying into the corridor, cut towards point where Rana slides. His awkward throw at DK can't be gathered and he only manages to parry it towards midwicket, which gives them the run
short of a length and pushed through quick at leg stump, punched to long-on
length and just outside off, punched to extra cover
good length and skidding onto leg stump, clipped to short fine
good length and skidding into leg stump, gets forward and jabs at that. Inside edge with the angle to short fine
full and wide outside off, driven firmly to extra cover
full on off stump, driven along the floor to long-off
short of a length outside off, mistimed punch to extra cover
full on leg stump, drives to long-on
tossed up outside off, leans in for the drive to long-off
length and loopy at leg stump, leans in and chips towards deep midwicket
driven between extra cover and mid-off. Good length and beating him in the flight outside off. His drive against the turn is aerial but it is in the gap
short and just outside off, cut straight to cover point
finds the gap between long-on and deep midwicket. Loopy and overpitched on leg stump, gets to the pitch of that and whips it perfectly to find the gap
good length and pushed down leg, shuffles to line up for the sweep but lets this go
starts with a boundary again. Length ball, flat and very wide outside off. Gets down and fetches it in trademark style with the sweep, aerial and past square leg
tossed up at off stump, sweet flowing drive to mid-off

long-on takes it running in! Wristspin release from around the wicket. Lobbed up at his toes and he looks to launch that between deep midwicket and long-on. Looks it's held its line and messed with his swing. Ends up chipping it high and Tripathi does well running in
full on middle stump, leans in and flicks to deep midwicket's left
offbreak, quicker and pushed through quick outside off. Driven straight to point
short of a length into the body again, waits on that and nudges it square of short fine
attempted legcutter is dropped short. Waits on the back foot and lifts that pull over midwicket
good length and skidding on outside off, jabbed towards point off the front foot
leading edge short of extra cover. Grips it at a length on off stump, QDK closes the face for the flick on the angle
length at off stump, defended down the pitch
short of a length outside off, turning away. Closes the face to get that to square and takes off. Rohit sends him back
tossed right up, met on the full and driven to deep midwicket's left
length outside off, some turn away. Chopped into the covers off the front foot
good length and turning into leg stump, flicked towards midwicket
outside edge on the full toss, taken on the bounce by QDK and it is celebration time
just clears mid-off but that isn't enough for KKR. Boult has all but sealed this. Yorker at off, he stays back and looks to loft that straight, can't get enough on it

rips off stump out and yells in delight! What an over! What a ball. Into the blockhole, angled away from middle and hitting off comprehenseively. Cummins was deep in the crease trying to hoick that over square leg. It is another dot ball and Karthik still at the non-striker's end

gets him off the leading edge! Superb change-up from Boult. Nails the yorker at leg stump. Russell is surprised, he's out of sorts, he's going back. Looks to jab that through square leg, Boult takes an easy one in the follow through. That's a dot ball and a new man at the crease now
shapes for the reverse ramp but gets no pace from Boult. Another cutter, dug in short. Manages to get bat on it but it is meek and to short third's left
inside edge as he looks to slap this short ball. It's a slower one, wide outside off. Can only get it to short fine

beaten again! Asks about the wide, but he had stepped a long way into the off side. Full slower ball again, dipping under his attempted sweep. Umpire explains why that couldn't be called. Krunal hares in from the boundary and gives Bumrah a hug
beaten. Loopy full slower ball outside off, steps out and is through the drive and swishing aimlessly as this dips under the bat
slower ball, dug into the pitch outside off. Shapes for the pull but gets that off the under-edge to long-on
he doesn't. Slower ball at a length outside off, chopped to extra cover's right
low full toss at middle stump, muscled along the floor to Pollard's right at long-on
offcutter at a length, wide outside off. Chopped on the up to sweeper's right. Krunal is lightning quick there again and keeps them to one
slow, at a length, and down leg side. Looks to sweep and cops that on the pad
beaten. Quicker length ball, outside off to adjust for Russell's middle stump guard. Looks to sweep and misses
full on off stump, driven to long-off

Bumrah has put it down! Russell's looked to send that out of the stadium and top-edged it. A length ball at middle, a miscued slog sweep. Russell thought he was gone. That wen very very high and Bumrah couldn't even get a hand on it at midwicket. Got woefully out of position by the end
good length at off stump, gets forward and looks to stab it into the covers for the single. Gets it straight to short extra
full and into leg stump, flicked to short fine
full and just outside off, springs into the stride to drive this to sweeper's right. Krunal's pace on the ground denies them a second, Russell won't risk it at the non-striker's end
inside edge as he looks to jab this offcutter off the front foot through cover
swung away to deep square's leg. Mumbai offering chances to Russell. Length ball in at the stumps, stands tall and swipes on the up with the angle
beats the outside edge. Good length and in the corridor, an anxious push in front of the body from Russell. Oh but the siren goes off, Bumrah has overstepped!
length at off stump, defended back to the bowler
bouncer at the shoulder, a controlled hook into the turf, out to fine leg
good length and in at off stump, solidly defended on the front foot
length on off stump, punched into the covers

dropped! Krunal is livid with himself. Length ball at middle stump, hard hands on the drive and to Krunal's right. He's covered it, he's behind it, but it catches him at the edge of the palm as he takes a tumble to his right. Oh that could prove so vital
nervous poke into the off side. Length ball at off, just past the fielder
full on leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket

lofted straight to deep square! KKR offering some real gifts to Mumbai here. This is full on middle stump, looks for the big slog sweep but is nowhere close to executing that. Sends it high and is taken well inside the boundary. Krunal delivered that from behind the crease, as he does often as a variation
short of a length at middle stump, punched back towards the bowler
stumped off Chahar's last ball! Sublime spell from Chahar. Saw Rana coming and pushed a slide through, across him. Rana was stranded. That was short of a length and past the outside edge
good length at the stumps, mistimed sweep, just out of reach of Rohit at midwicket

through everyone! Chahar is too good to handle tonight. Good length ball outside off, Shakib looking to drive on line and is completely flummoxed. Big spin into him, lots of bounce, and past the keeper
dropped short at middle stump, pulled to deep square's left
length at leg stump, steps out and flicks to deep square
good length at off stump, leans in and gets this off the inside edge to deep square
full on middle stump, steps out and drives to long-on
full and just outside off, gets low for the drive to sweeper cover
full and drifted into leg stump, leans in for the flick to deep square
length at middle stump, steps out and drives to long-on
length at middle stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
under edge from between QDK's legs. Short of a length and sliding on. he shapes to cut but that comes on with the angle
length at middle stump, gets low for the sweep, gets it off the inside edge. Can't beat Hardik to the left at short fine

holes out to deep midwicket! Superb, superb bowling again from Chahar. Hangs it up at a length, wide outside off and dipping quickly at him. He steps out and is made to reach out for this slog. Not in position to execute it and he has his man
short of a length and ripping in sharply from outside off. Has to defend after shaping to punch through cover
full, possibly a googly, at leg stump. Leans in and chips it to long-off's right. Brings up his second consecutive fifty. Raises the bat and points to the crest as his team claps for him
loopy legbreak beats his forward jab and catches him on the body
good length and down leg side, reaches out for a sweep and gets that fine off the top edge...scratch that, it's off the spine of the bat. He was through that too early
yorker at leg stump, dug out with a flick to deep square
short of a length outside off, sweetly timed back foot punch to sweeper's right
how. So easy from Morgan. Short and angled in at off stump. He is upright, and ramps this from right in front of his chest. There was absolutely no room there, brilliant
full and into the pads, can't get bat on the attempted flick. Bumrah's appeal is turned down
offcutter at a length, but down leg side. Waits on it and tickles it off the pad to beat fine leg to the left
short of a length at off stump, aerial punch off the back foot to sweeper cover
short of a length and turning into off stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
appeal for lbw but that's turning down leg. Beaten on the forward block
appeal for catch at leg slip but that came off the thigh. Back of a length and rising sharply to beat Morgan's attempted glance

spins a long way and draws the edge! Short of a length legbreak from just outside leg. He closes the face to try and stab that through midwicket but that rips quickly and he's caught off the outside edge
steps across and ramps that fine. Full on middle stump, goes a bit early but keeps his eyes on the ball. Bumrah cleans up from short third man
length and turning into leg stump, flicked to deep square's right
yorker length at middle stump, pushed down to long-on
yorker length at off stump, backs into the leg side, probably expecting a short one. Stabs it straight to point
slower short ball outside off, waits on it and pulls over midwicket. Picked the spot perfectly
short on at leg stump, pulled on the bounce to fine leg
low full toss on middle stump, punched to long-on
short and across off stump, leaps to get a touch on that. Steered to third man
just short of deep midwicket. Legbreak tossed up at a length on outside off. Brings out the sweep first up but isn't in control and ends up slicing that

holes out to long-off. A subtle change from Chahar - a bit quicker, a bit fuller, a bit closer to the body. Gill clears the front leg and wants to pump this straight, but it's come off the low part of his bat. Chahar is uproarious
crunched wide of long-on! Uses his reaches to get to the pitch of this length ball at middle, doesn't let it turn and swings cleanly through the line
short and turning away from off. Gets big on him and he mistimes the cut
just short of short midwicket. Length ball at middle stump, looked to punch that into the leg side for a single
dropped short at leg stump, waits on that places the pull well behind square leg
short of a length outside off, pulled off the front foot to deep midwicket
length at leg stump, shuffles and pats to long-on
slapped wide of sweeper cover! Cutter, dug in at a length just outside off. Waits on the back foot and gets quick feet to make room and cut this over extra
swung wide of deep midwicket. Short of a length and just outside off, shuffles and gets a clean swing at this. Boult slides to his left but can't get close to that
length and just outside off, jabbed into the off side
full and just outside off, looks for the reverse sweep and is beaten
full on leg stump, dabbed through square leg off the front foot
length and sliding onto leg stump, pushed to midwicket's right off the inside edge
full on middle stump, flicked to deep midwicket
short of a length, sliding across the corridor. Beaten on the cut
good length on middle stump, punched to mid-on off the back foot
length at leg stump, shapes for the paddle sweep, adjusts to drop it into the leg side
pummeled past the bowler! Whew, that is dominant batting. Length ball outside off, a trigger movement takes him towards off stump. Then he clears the front leg and hammers this on the rise
offcutter at a length, wide outside off. Can't attempt a shot at that because he had backed a long way into the leg side expecting the angle into him
conventional pull this time to beat deep square to the right! Nice wrists from Gill. Short of a length in the corridor, a slight shuffle and times the closing of the face pefectly
clubbed over mid-on. Offcutter at a length outside off, rising for him and an angled bat front-foot pull from Gill
length and just outside off, punched on the rise to mid-off

good length and tight at the stumps. Tight run-out chance but Jansen can't kick the ball onto the stumps. Would have been out if he had. Length ball dropped into the pitch and hesitation from Gill as he calls for the run
length at leg stump, delivered from behind the crease again. Steps out and flicks to square leg
length ball, delivered from a foot behind the crease. Punched to extra cover on the up
length at middle stump, punched to square leg off the back foot
good length on off stump, pushed back to the bowler off the front foot
length at off stump, dropped into the off side with soft hands
full and drifted into leg stump, flicked to square leg
short of a length and down leg side, left alone
pristine. Length ball into the corridor, lovely stride, high elbow, full face - punched past the bowler's boots
short at the hips, shoveled to fine leg with the angle
slower ball at a length on middle stump, looks to glance through square leg. That holds in the surface and gets him on the thigh
good length and into middle stump, defended to midwicket with the angle
short of a length and slanted into the thigh, swivels for the pull and that trickles fine off the thigh
short of a length and just outside off from around the wicket, defended into the off side
the slowest of short balls. 97.9kph! Loops on Rana and he waits and waits to drag this to deep square from outside off
another short one at off stump, makes room for the upper cut again but this is quickly past the bat

short and wide outside off. He anticipated that - it was a short one fourth ball last over as well. Made the room, but too eager on the cut. That doesn't come, rolls into the off side off the under-edge
into the leg side this time. Length outside off, shuffles to get behind the line and an inelegant hoick over midwicket. Good enough during the powerplay
good length outside off, punched on the rise to cover point
steps out and blazes that over cover! Length at off stump, down the track and into the leg side to make room and a sweet connection. Is that you, Sanath?
good length and just outside off, jabbed to point off the front foot
inside edge onto pad. Short and just outside off, through the pull too early
length at middle stump, drives on the rise. Off the inside half to mid-on's right
short of a length and just outside off, 131kph, punched on the bounce to extra cover
short of a length and across off stump. Under-edge on the attempted square drive
full and at leg stump, leans in for the flick to deep square's left
good length and swung away from off stump. Gets behind the line and defends watchfully
short of a length, swung away from off stump. Left alone
short and nicely delivered in the corridor, sways away from that to leave
beaten on the outside edge. Lovely shape here for Boult. Length and swung way from the corridor, Rana nowhere close to getting that drive away
good length and curved away outside off, shuffles and dabs it towards point
sweetly driven through the covers. Full outswinger, leans in, gets low, caresses that
